preserved_policy.preservation: Original bytes, identities, prototypes, parameters and selected tiles are not changed.

source_manifest.note: Source/config hashes are authoritative; transport may omit .git.

analysis_policy: Compare within-cohort paired results and report cohorts separately; do not pool raw timings.

precision_contract.note: The Strassen pre-add rounding is part of the algorithm under test; its numerical cost must remain visible. FP32 output differs from some historical BF16-output experiments.

runtime_identity_scope: Separate logical allocations; physical chip serial unavailable.
